description: Machine-readable SLI definitions for CAP. Each SLI declares WHAT is measured, its unit, the measurement formula, and WHERE the raw signal lives. SLO targets (GA-GATE 30) are derived from real measured distributions, never invented here.

slis.description: Fraction of API health probes answered with a success status by the backend deployment.
slis.measurement: successful_probes / total_probes over the measurement window

slis.description: 95th percentile end-to-end latency of authenticated API requests.
slis.measurement: quantile(0.95) of request durations sampled by the load harness

slis.description: Fraction of plugin executions reaching a terminal SUCCEEDED state (excluding user cancellations).
Rate at which a HEALTHY run's lease is reclaimed by another worker while the original worker still holds it.
slis.measurement: false_reclaim_events / started_runs; heartbeat PRE-GATE B/E regressions pin this to zero

slis.description: Fraction of sandbox pod spawns that fail to become Ready within the spawn deadline.
slis.measurement: failed_spawns / total_spawns observed by the K8s provider

slis.description: Measured data-loss window of the last full disaster-recovery restore.
slis.measurement: observed_rpo_seconds recorded by the DR module into ga-dr-context.json

slis.description: Measured wall-clock time from cluster destruction to fully restored service.
slis.measurement: rto_seconds recorded by the DR module into ga-dr-context.json

slis.description: Count of orphaned sandboxes/evidence objects accumulating after the soak workload (must converge to zero).
slis.measurement: reconciliation scan output after final GC pass
